card.name: The word at in 'patients at risk'
card.fires_on: The word 'at' right after 'patients' (or 'who are') when it leads into 'risk for' a condition. It also fires weakly on 'early' in 'patients with early breast cancer'.

modes.label: At before risk
modes.description: The word 'at' after 'patients' or 'are' that introduces 'risk for' or 'higher risk'.

modes.label: Early after patients with
modes.description: The word 'early' describing a disease stage after 'patients with'.
modes.example: VERZENIO has not been studied in patients with<< early>> breast cancer who had a history of V
